categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Carries the Validation label, edits validation.cpp, and modifies assumeutxo cache management in PopulateAndValidateSnapshot.
categories.rationale: Prevents memory exhaustion crashes during assumeutxo snapshot loading by checking byte usage rather than relying solely on coin counts. As noted in the description, snapshots containing coins with large scripts could overshoot dbcache by up to roughly 1.2 GB before being checked, causing an out-of-memory crash on memory-constrained devices before the UTXO set hash is verified.
